Dot plot of top ligand-receptor pair contributions (LIANA-style)

Source: R/LR_Contributions.R
plotLRContributions.Rd

Ranks ligand-receptor pairs by mean contribution (within each Edge separately) and plots the top ones as a dot per patient x pair: dot size is PctOfTotal, dot color is the raw Contribution.

Usage

plotLRContributions(lr_contrib, top_n = 15, title = NULL)

Arguments

lr_contrib

Output of computeLRContributions().

top_n

Number of top ligand-receptor pairs to show per Edge.

title

Plot title. Defaults to NULL, which auto-generates one naming the cell type(s) involved (e.g. "Top ligand-receptor pairs: CLL - NKcells"), derived from lr_contrib's Sender/Receiver columns.

Value

A ggplot2 object.

Examples

data(skcm_example)
lr <- computeLRContributions(
  Lmatrix = skcm_example$Lmatrix, Rmatrix = skcm_example$Rmatrix,
  Cmatrix = skcm_example$Cmatrix, LRmatrix = skcm_example$LRmatrix,
  celltypes = skcm_example$celltypes, sender = "Tumor", receiver = "CD8+ T"
)
if (requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
  plotLRContributions(lr, top_n = 10)
}
